new file mode 100644
index 00000000..3e4d56c7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/check_panel_width.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.panel import Panel
+
+console = Console(width=20)
+panel = Panel("Hello")
+# If it's shrink-wrapped, it should be 7 chars wide (|Hello|)
+# If it expands, it should be 20 chars wide.
+
+rendered = console.render(panel)
+# We can't easily check the width of rendered segments here, 
+# but we can check if there are trailing spaces.
+
+# Let's just print it and see.
+console.print(panel)
diff --git a/check_panel_width_debug.py b/check_panel_width_debug.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..8927436a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/check_panel_width_debug.py
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.panel import Panel
+import io
+import sys
+
+sys.stdout = io.StringIO()
+console = Console(width=20, force_terminal=True)
+panel = Panel("Hello")
+console.print(panel)
+output = sys.stdout.getvalue()
+sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
+
+print(f"Output:\n{output}")
+print(f"First line length: {len(output.splitlines()[0])}")
diff --git a/check_panel_width_repr.py b/check_panel_width_repr.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..d08918ac
--- /dev/null
+++ b/check_panel_width_repr.py
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.panel import Panel
+
+console = Console(width=20, force_terminal=True)
+panel = Panel("Hello")
+# We use a list to capture the output
+import io
+from rich.console import Console
+import sys
+
+# Redirect stdout to a string buffer
+sys.stdout = io.StringIO()
+console = Console(width=20, force_terminal=True)
+console.print(panel)
+output = sys.stdout.getvalue()
+sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
+
+print(repr(output))
